SELECT path, count(*) AS revisions

### Reference

```ts
const withRetry = async <T>(fn: () => Promise<T>, attempts = 3): Promise<T> => {
  let lastError: unknown
  for (let i = 0; i < attempts; i++) {
    try {
      return await fn()
    } catch (error) {
      lastError = error
      await sleep(2 ** i * 250)
    }
  }
  throw lastError
}
```

export async function drainQueue(batchSize = 64): Promise<number> {
